'''"Studies in Contemporary Non-Human Music and Dance"''' was a [[Music/Legends|music]] program offered at the [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]]. An individual known as [[Prydde]] suggested on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] that shipping in musical instruments for the new program would be a quick way to earn money legally.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
